events.name: Bash
events.head: Check worktree state, upstream changes and private stack ports
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t424-wt && git status --short | head -20 && git log --oneline -5 && git fetch -q origin && git log --oneline HEAD..origin/main | head -20; lsof -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -P | grep -E ':894[0-4]' | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check merge status and stack ports
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t424-wt && git log --oneline HEAD..origin/main | wc -l; git merge-base --is-ancestor 6f7df8e2 HEAD && echo t299-in; for p in 8940 8941 8942 8943 8944; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "$p %{http_code}\n" --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:$p/; done; ls /tmp/t424* -d 2>/dev/null; ls /private/tmp/t424-wt/*.sh /tmp/t424/ 2>/dev/null | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect T-299 commit and stack scripts
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t424-wt && git cat-file -t 6f7df8e2 2>&1; git log --oneline origin/main -3; git log --oneline --grep=T-299 -3 HEAD; cat /tmp/t424/stack.sh | head -50; echo ---; cat /tmp/t424/sim-reset.sh

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate T-299 commit
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t424-wt && git log -1 --format='%h %s %cd' 6f7df8e2; git branch -a --contains 6f7df8e2 | head; git merge-base --is-ancestor 6f7df8e2 origin/main && echo on-main

events.name: Bash
events.head: Compare local main, origin/main and branch
events.input: $ git rev-list --count origin/main..main; git rev-list --count main..origin/main; git rev-list --count t424-chain-probes..main; git log --oneline origin/main..main | grep -v 'Agent T-\|Blocker\|board' | head; git log --oneline origin/main..main | grep -c T-299
